_comment: Copy this file to config/local.json (gitignored) to activate the deployment profile. Values replace the matching keys in config/default.json; 'keywords' are unioned. Never put API keys here — keys are entered at runtime on-device and stored in the Android Keystore.
transcriptionContext:
Transcribe natural dictation faithfully.

The speaker may switch between Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) and English.
Preserve the original language of each phrase.
Use Traditional Chinese for Chinese speech.

Preserve punctuation, capitalization, acronyms, product names, code identifiers, and technical terminology.

Do not translate, summarize, paraphrase, or add content.

The speaker is a software engineer and may discuss software development, AI coding tools, EDA, digital design, and formal verification.
